default/30428.htm.text: Perrin: We must all serve the saint! The one that performs holy miracles from the gods to cure the diseased! The holy one who received the prophecy of the heavens and came to save the world! Salvation is awaiting you! Abandon all you have and follow the saint!

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30428-01.html.text: Perrin: Ah, the saint! Oh, yes, you have the right person for any question you may have about the saint... You must be a representative of the shrine. I've been expecting you. If you like, I could let you take her with you. Better than just having a meeting with her, huh? But, one condition... We h…

links.text: "Tell me the truth or you will get hurt!"

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30428-03.html.text: Perrin: Hey, hey! Easy there...! OK, if 100,000 is too much how about 90,000... 80,000... OK, let's make it half, 50,000! Don't look at me like that... Please, at least 1,000 Adena... Stop it! OK, OK! The truth! I have only heard of the saint! At one time I was seeing a girl named Allana ... She to…

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30428-04.html.text: Perrin: Please, that is all I know! You should ask Allana for the details! She lives near the harbor ! I am very busy, so please excuse me.

Q00409_PathOfTheElvenOracle/30428-04.htm.text: Perrin: Eek! You've killed Tamil ...! Look here! Help! Ok, ok, I was wrong!!! All, all right ...! You want the money? Take it ...! Take all of it!

Q00409_PathOfTheElvenOracle/30428-05.htm.text: Perrin: I do not have anything. You may even search me ... But I really don't have anything ... Please believe me.
